exercises.instructions: Choose the correct preposition of time (in, on, at) for each sentence.

questions.question: We start school ___ half past eight.
questions.explanation: 'at' is used with specific times like 'half past eight'. 'at' ကို အချိန်တိတိမှတ်တိတွေနဲ့ သုံးပါ။

questions.question: I don't go to school ___ Saturday.
questions.explanation: 'on' is used with days like 'Saturday'. 'on' ကို နေ့တွေနဲ့ သုံးပါ။

questions.question: Classes finish ___ the afternoon.
questions.explanation: 'in' is used with parts of the day like 'the afternoon'. 'in' ကို နေ့ပိုင်းတွေနဲ့ သုံးပါ။

questions.question: They start school ___ June.
questions.explanation: 'in' is used with months like 'June'. 'in' ကို လတွေနဲ့ သုံးပါ။

questions.question: Schools start ___ 7th September.
questions.explanation: 'on' is used with specific dates like '7th September'. 'on' ကို ရက်စွဲတွေနဲ့ သုံးပါ။

questions.question: We do homework ___ night.
questions.explanation: 'at' is used with 'night'. 'at' ကို 'night' နဲ့ သုံးပါ။

questions.question: She wants to go to school ___ the weekend.
questions.explanation: 'at' is used with 'the weekend'. 'at' ကို 'the weekend' နဲ့ သုံးပါ။

questions.question: My birthday is ___ January.
questions.explanation: 'in' is used with months like 'January'. 'in' ကို လတွေနဲ့ သုံးပါ။

questions.question: I study Spanish ___ the evening.
questions.explanation: 'in' is used with parts of the day like 'the evening'. 'in' ကို နေ့ပိုင်းတွေနဲ့ သုံးပါ။

questions.question: The programme starts ___ 7.30 pm.
questions.explanation: 'at' is used with specific times like '7.30 pm'. 'at' ကို အချိန်တိတိမှတ်တိတွေနဲ့ သုံးပါ။

questions.question: Can you come ___ Monday?
questions.explanation: 'on' is used with days like 'Monday'. 'on' ကို နေ့တွေနဲ့ သုံးပါ။

questions.question: It rains a lot ___ winter.

questions.question: I usually get up ___ half past eight.
questions.explanation: 'at' is used with specific times like 'half past eight'. 'at' ကို အချိန်တိတိမှတ်တိတွေနဲ့ သုံးပါ။
